test_title: RRB NTPC CBT 2 (Level-3) Official Paper (Held On: 17 June 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: As per World Health Organization, keeping salt intake to less than ______ helps to prevent hypertension, and reduces the risk of heart disease and stroke in the adult population.
solution:
The correct answer is __**5 g per day**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Salt Intake**

 
 
• **Salt is the main source of sodium** in our diet, however sodium glutamate, a condiment used in many cultures, can also include sodium.
 
• **Low potassium** intake (less than 3.5 grams/day) and **high sodium** intake (>2 grams/day, equivalent to 5 g of salt/day) both contribute to high blood pressure and raise the risk of **cardiovascular disease and stroke**.
 
• According to the **World Health Organization (WHO)**, persons who consume less than **5 g of salt** daily have lower blood pressure and a lower chance of developing heart disease, stroke, and coronary heart attack.
 
• Cutting less on salt has several advantages, but the main one is a **decrease in high blood pressure**.
 
• By **2025**, the WHO Member States intend to cut world salt use by a relative **30 %**.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Most people use twice as much salt as is advised—on average, **9 to 12 g per day**.
 
• One of the **most economical steps** a nation can take to improve population health outcomes has been identified as** reducing salt intake**.
 
• If worldwide salt consumption were reduced to the recommended amount then it is predicted that **2.5 million fatalities may be avoided annually**.
 
• According to WHO, **the maximum recommended salt consumption for adults should be reduced for children between the ages of two to fifteen based on their proportional energy needs to those of adults**.
 
• Around** 75% of the salt consumed** daily in many high-income nations **comes from processed foods and meals** served outside the home.
